name: davideasaf-marketplace
description: A personal marketplace of reusable AI skills, plugins, and MCP-powered workflows for development, research, media, finance, and model collaboration.

plugins.name: github-dev-flow
plugins.description: Manages GitHub issue-based development workflows with project board integration, worktree isolation, and structured planning phases. Supports single issue work, batch processing, milestone completion, and status reporting.

plugins.name: image-search
plugins.description: Describe the image you want and pull it from the internet

plugins.name: monarch-money
plugins.description: Claude toolkit to interact, categorize, and plan using Monarch Money

plugins.name: linear-dev-flow
plugins.description: Manages Linear issue-based development workflows with workflow state integration, worktree isolation, and structured planning phases. Agent creates plans in Todo, implements from Dev Ready, and delivers to In Review for human validation.

plugins.name: ask-models
plugins.description: Second opinions from other AI models via orchestration-friendly CLI wrappers: Claude Opus, OpenAI Codex/GPT, Cursor-hosted models, and Antigravity/Gemini.

plugins.name: media-tools
plugins.description: Transcribe/diarize audio & video, clean WebVTT transcripts, and generate or edit images via Gemini (nanobanana) and OpenAI Codex.

plugins.name: browser-tools
plugins.description: Stealth Chrome automation for CAPTCHA / bot-detected sites when standard headless automation gets blocked.

plugins.name: dev-utils
plugins.description: Developer utilities: git worktrees (with .worktreeinclude copy support) and styled Mermaid diagram building.

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: Research & knowledge tools: NotebookLM API and structured YouTube search with insights.

plugins.name: fable
plugins.description: Use Cursor-hosted Fable 5 as an on-demand strategic advisor or as a durable orchestrator for bounded Ask Codex worker programs.
